# Jaime Brenes Reyes · Grant Writing & Research Consulting

> Grant writing and research consulting based in London, Ontario, working remotely. For university researchers, nonprofits, research offices, and artists and grassroots groups (reduced rates). English and Spanish. Tagline: "You do the research. I write the grant."

## Services
- Funder scan & fit review: which programs fit, and whether the applicant is eligible, before writing starts.
- Full application writing: narrative, budget justification, letters of support, compliance and co-applicant coordination.
- Review & reviewer stress test: editing an existing draft, reading it as the review panel will, and rewriting.
- Partnership & support letters: MOUs, letters of support and partner follow-up.
- Reporting: interim and final reports to funders.
- Knowledge mobilization: researcher portfolio sites and plain-language summaries after the award.

## Experience
- Research Associate, Financial Wellness Lab, Western University (2023–2025).
- Co-wrote the lab's successful Ontario Research Fund proposal, matching researchers with industry partners and collecting letters of support.
- Led writing and coordination of an NSERC Alliance application.
- Worked with the Principal Investigator on an SSHRC Partnership Grant application (Canada, El Salvador, the Netherlands, Belgium), including the literature review, theoretical framework and budget.
- Board Member and Secretary, Heart Links Lazos de Corazón (London, Ontario nonprofit).
- Ph.D. in Hispanic Studies, Western University.

## Principles
- No guaranteed-funding claims.
- Client material stays confidential; any tool is cleared with the client and checked against the funder's rules first.
